author: Karl Rock
description:
What's the secret to a perfectly juicy Chicken Sajji?

It's all in the cooking! This traditional Balochi dish is slow-roasted over hot coals, allowing the chicken to cook gradually until it's beautifully tender, juicy and succulent, with that irresistible smoky flavour.

Sometimes, the secret to incredible food is simply taking your time!

Would you try this Balochi Chicken Sajji?
title: The Secret to Juicy Chicken Sajji!

author: Karl Rock
description:
I’ve finally tried Balochi food in Pakistan! I’ve wanted to try Balochi cuisine for a long time, but travelling through Balochistan isn’t always easy. So instead, I headed to a restaurant in Karachi to get a taste of some traditional Balochi food and find out what it’s really like.

The star of this video is Balochi Sajji, one of the most famous foods associated with Balochistan. I get to see how it’s prepared, explore the restaurant’s huge kitchen, and then finally sit down to try it for myself.

But Balochi cuisine is about much more than Sajji. I also learn about traditional foods including Laandhi, dried meat, Kaak, a hard bread traditionally baked around a stone, and Gwadari Halwa, a distinctive green semolina sweet cooked over a wood fire.
